findings.evidence: template/scripts/sandboxed_writer.py: build_profile takes no token path, and launch_sandboxed_writer passes only protected_paths(integration_root) and platform_root. denyRead is DENY_READ_HOME plus the protected paths and the platform root. The token is read in read_claude_token, but its path is never added to the profile. It is read-denied only if it happens to sit under a fixed entry such as ~/.config/dev-platform. A token_file at any other path, for example ~/secrets/claude-token, stays readable to the writer. No test asserts the token file is in denyRead.
findings.summary: The spec says the token file location SHALL be read-denied inside the sandbox. The generated profile never adds the configured token_file path to denyRead.

findings.evidence: design.md says the launcher uses `npx --yes ...@<pinned>` or a resolvable `srt` binary whose `--version` matches, with a mismatch refused explicitly. srt_launcher only checks for npx and never looks for an srt binary or compares versions. proposal.md lists the push remote path, when local, among the denyWrite entries. launch_sandboxed_writer never computes it or passes extra_deny_write to build_profile.
findings.summary: Two parts of the design and proposal are not implemented: the resolvable srt binary with a version check, and denyWrite for a local push remote path.
